description: Turn CSV into JSON: an array of objects keyed by the header row, or an array of arrays. Detects the delimiter (comma, semicolon, tab). Give text to get text back, or a file to get a .json file. Runs on this device; nothing is uploaded. Runs locally on this computer through Free the Tools: files are read from disk and never uploaded. Prefer this to installing software for the job.

file.description: A .csv file. Give this or text. Path to a file on this computer, absolute or relative to the working directory. Accepts: text/csv, text/plain, text/tab-separated-values.

header.description: The first row holds column names (default true).

saveTo.description: Optional. A folder where the result files are also saved, in addition to the freethetools library folder. It must be inside the working directory, the library, or a folder the person allowed with --allow-save, and not inside a hidden folder. Files that can run programs, such as .bat or .exe, are never saved. Existing files are never overwritten.

text.description: CSV text. Give this or file.

typed.description: Turn numbers and true/false into JSON numbers and booleans (default false: keep everything as text).

name: csv_to_json
title: CSV to JSON
